sources.note: Nothing on word stress. Moba: 'La melodie reste reservee aux realisations des tons (4 tons et downstep)'; statement/question distinguished by abrupt (glottal) vs gradual voice offset plus final-vowel lengthening.

sources.citation: Pike, Kenneth L. 1982. Tune and tone: generalized syntagmatic pitch patterns constrained by particular lexical patterns. Journal of West African Languages 12(2): 22-41.
sources.note: Nothing for Bimoba/Moba. Sect. IV presents Jann Russell's MOBA (mfq, Togo) tone-sandhi matrices ('Four phonemic levels of tone seem verified'); the stress discussion (sect. VI.C and fn. 9, prepausal stress) concerns Ebrie (Kwa), not Moba. Bimoba appears only as a citation of Jacobs & Pike 1968.
